name: openai-legacy-compat-closeout
title: Retire explicit OpenAI adapter legacy compat surfaces
description: Close out the remaining explicit OpenAI-compatible legacy adapter entrypoints and re-export facades now that the live runtime defaults to protocol-safe chat/stream orchestration.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-21 full-repo audit confirmed that the live OpenAI adapter public entrypoints already route through protocol-safe chat/stream methods, but the package still exposes explicit legacy compat entrypoints and compatibility re-export modules under openai_compatible.compat/**. Those surfaces are now isolated governance debt rather than live runtime owners, and the new SaaS should either remove them or quarantine only the truly necessary low-level helpers instead of keeping legacy compat as a first-class package contract.
